collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager ties a long tail of knotted leaves to a kite made of palm fronds.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) ties a long tail of knotted leaves to a kite made of palm fronds. The kite climbs higher than anyone expected, and a small crowd gathers to watch.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) ties a long tail of knotted leaves to a kite made of palm fronds. The kite spins twice and lands in a bush, and (name1) laughs and tries again.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) ties a long tail of knotted leaves to a kite made of palm fronds. A gull circles the kite curiously before deciding it is not worth the trouble.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) ties a long tail of knotted leaves to a kite made of palm fronds. By sunset, three children are taking turns holding the string.
